_readme: Rwanda administrative divisions. Rows are [code, name] plus, for provinces, [code, name, name_rw]. Provinces, districts and sectors also carry [lat, lng] when an OpenStreetMap centroid is known (null when it is not). Parentage comes from the code: a sector code is its district code, a hyphen and its own slug. Built by scripts/build-locations.mjs from https://iremeairwanda-1.onrender.com/api/locations
